text: A lovely spot for a quiet afternoon coffee. Smooth latte, welcoming staff, and a calm atmosphere you can really relax in.
name: Muhamad

text: The most thoughtfully run coffee house I've visited. The espresso was rich and clean, and the atmosphere was calm enough to actually get work done. I'll be back.
name: Peter

text: Came for the coffee, stayed for the hospitality. The signature drink was fantastic, the pastries perfect — and they remembered my order. This is what a neighborhood coffee house should be.
name: Andrew
